hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in */aulas/aula*.html) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; r=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/tools/check_slides.py" "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s\n" "$r"; exit 2; fi; exit 0; }
